_comment: Test run: theseus rebase from A=google/t5-v1_1-base to B=google/t5-v1_1-large on MNLI only. B's classification head is NOT trained -- it is the nearest-class-mean (cosine) head built by scripts/build_nearest_mean_head.py, pointed to via target_task_heads. See scripts/sbatch_text_rebase_theseus_t5base_t5large.sh for the two-step run (build head, then this config).
_todo_tuned_ckpts: Path below follows the naming convention finetune/train_text.py already uses (google__t5-v1_1-base/mnli/full_best_ep.pt) but is NOT verified against your cluster storage -- update it to wherever A's MNLI fine-tune actually lives, or produce it first with: python -m merge_and_rebase.finetune.train_text --text-config <your config> --tasks mnli.
